summary.headline: Vatican Codex Astrological Extracts
summary.text: Catalog of Vatican codex folios 14–48, listing astrological excerpts on star calculations, climacterics, inceptions, colors, lots, planetary mixtures, places, Moon and Mercury, universal observations, and the significations of the seven stars in the signs. Authorities and cross-references include Hermes Trismegistus, Paulus Alexandrinus, Valens, Porphyry, and Hephaestus, with parallels in Florentine and Venetian codices.
